title: Red Arrow
description: Change the arrow color to red for better visibility.
body:
**Red Arrow**

Red Arrow is a small cosmetic resource pack that changes the arrow color to a bright 
red for better visibility in everyday gameplay.  
It makes arrows easier to see both in the air and after they land, while keeping all other textures and gameplay unchanged.

**Features:**

•Recolors the arrow to a vivid red so shots are easier to track

•Useful for PvP, fighting skeletons, and practicing long‑range shots

•Very lightweight: only edits the arrow texture, with no performance impact

**License / Permissions:**

•The arrow texture in this pack is my own edit of the vanilla asset.

•Do not re‑upload this pack to other sites.

•You may use it in videos or modpacks; a credit link is appreciated but not required.
